restartStrategy.title: Restart strategi
restartStrategy.desc: Pilih how instance are restarted. Each option affects cakupan dan stability.

safe.title: Safe restart (disarankan)
safe.principle: Send SIGTERM untuk the target instance processes so the aplikasi bisa save dan exit, lalu jalankan ulang itu instance (paksa matiin kalau needed).
safe.pros: Closer untuk a normal exit, less likely untuk pemicu crash prompts, safer buat data.
safe.cons: May take longer saat nunggu buat a graceful shutdown.

force.title: Paksa restart
force.principle: Match processes berdasarkan --user-data-dir dan hentikan them paksa (SIGKILL / taskkill /F), lalu jalankan ulang the target instance.
force.pros: Bisa precisely restart a single instance.
force.cons: May pemicu “unexpected keluar” prompts dan risk losing unsaved data.

flowNotice.desc: Lagi ganti akun requires reading VS Code lokal auth penyimpanan dan pakai the sistem kredensial layanan buat dekripsi/write-back. Data is diproses locally cuma.
flowNotice.inject: One-click lagi ganti: Ini tool membaca lokal VS Code enkripsi material (DPAPI/Keychain/Secret Layanan), decrypts the auth session di status.vscdb, replaces the GitHub Copilot token, dan re-encrypts it — semua locally di your mesin.
flowNotice.reason: Permission cakupan: baca VS Code auth database (status.vscdb) dan call sistem kredensial capability (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Layanan) buat dekripsi/write-back.
flowNotice.storage: Data cakupan: cuma GitHub auth-session related entries are baca/diperbarui; semua processes jalan locally.
